## Change

Explain the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue when applicable.

## Verification

Describe the tests run and include screenshots for visible UI changes. Mention migration or backup steps when applicable.

- [ ] The latest `test` check passes on this PR's current commit.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff and relevant QA results before merging.

Solo workflow: no additional reviewer approval is required. New commits require a fresh CI result. While private-repository branch protection is unavailable, the merge decision remains manual.
